title: Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - Post-Award Formalities - Intent to Award
subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: What is the primary operational purpose of issuing a formal Notice of Intent to Award (NOI)?
options: To authorize the vendor to immediately begin work and submit invoices
To publicly announce the anticipated winning vendor, which triggers the official protest window for aggrieved vendors before the final contract is signed
To cancel the solicitation process entirely
To officially reject all non-responsive bids
questions.explain: The Notice of Intent to Award provides public transparency regarding the agency's selection decision. It starts the legal clock (usually 5-10 days) allowing unsuccessful vendors to file a formal protest before the agency signs the binding contract.
